[[Corporal]] '''Ansin Thobel''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Imperial Navy]], stationed as a [[Death Star Trooper|trooper]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. Primarily tasked with keeping the [[Battle station|station]] secure, Thobel was also cross-trained in operational duties and sometimes manned a [[sensor]] suite.

In [[1 BBY]], Thobel took part in the firing sequence when the [[Death Star]] fired on [[Jedha City]] and [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] it during the first test of the [[Space station|station's]] [[Mk I Superlaser|superlaser]]. He then also took part in the firing sequence when the Death Star fired on the [[Citadel Tower]] on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]] in an unsuccessful attempt to stop the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] from [[Battle of Scarif|stealing]] the [[Death Star plans]].

==Biography==
===First shot===
{{Quote|Target Jedha City. Prepare single reactor ignition.|Krennic gives orders to fire on Jedha to Thobel and others operating the superlaser|audio=TargetJedhaCity-Krennic.flac|<ref name="RO" />}}
[[File:ThobelButtons-Encyclopedia.png|thumb|left|300px|Ansin Thobel served as a Death Star Trooper, working as both a sentry and manning a sensor suite.]]
Ansin Thobel was a [[human]] who served as a [[Imperial Navy Trooper|trooper]] within the [[Imperial Navy]]<ref name="SWROUVG" /> during the [[Imperial Era|heyday]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Finest" /> Holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[corporal]]<ref name="SWROUVG" /> in the [[infantry]],<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> he was trained in shipboard combat, repulsing boarders, and pacifying escaped [[prisoner]]s, with cross training in operational duties. Thobel was eventually transferred to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] and became a [[Death Star Trooper]]<ref name="SWROUVG" /> [[squad]] [[commander]],<ref name="Collectors">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story – The Official Collector's Edition|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' – The Official Collector's Edition]]</ref> with his primary role being securing the [[Battle station|station]] through sentry duty and patrols.<ref name="Geektionary" /> He worked sentry duty shifts in the [[Space station|station's]] command sector,<ref name="SWROUVG" /> and, in order to protect important personnel like [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] or [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]], he was sometimes stationed on the [[Overbridge (Death Star I)|command bridge]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> When not on sentry duty, the [[Death Star trooper officer corps|officer]] manned a [[sensor]] suite station in the general sector.<ref name="SWROUVG" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Death Star]]'s construction was completed, and it traveled to the [[Jedha system]] in order to carry out a test of its [[Mk I Superlaser|superlaser]] for the first [[time]]. Once the station was over the [[moon]] of [[Jedha]], Krennic gave the order for the [[Superlaser|laser]] to fire on a single [[reactor]] ignition in order to [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroy]] [[Jedha City]] on the moon below. During the firing sequence for the [[weapon]], Thobel turned a numbered dial at a large control station before a [[Imperial weapons technician|weapons technician]] began punching buttons beside the [[trooper]]. The weapon then fired, obliterating the [[city]]. The successful test prompted Tarkin to replace Krennic as [[Commanding officer|commander]] of the Death Star.<ref name="RO" />

===Second shot===
{{Quote|Commence primary ignition sequence.|An automated voice as Thobel turns a dial|audio=CommencePrimaryIgnition.flac|<ref name="RO" />}}
[[File:CitadelTowerDestroyedStarWars.png|thumb|right|300px|Thobel took part in the firing sequence that destroyed the Citadel Tower on Scarif.]]
Shortly after the destruction of Jedha City, Tarkin learned that [[Rogue One|members]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]], the location of the [[Death Star plans]], and so he ordered that the station travel to the [[Scarif system]]. Once there, Tarkin found an [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance fleet]] in [[orbit]] attempting to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the plans. To try and prevent this, Tarkin ordered that the Death Star fire on the [[Citadel Tower]] on Scarif where the plans were stored. As primary ignition of a single reactor commenced in the firing sequence, Thobel once again pressed the numbered dial.<ref name="RO" />

The [[Laser|superlaser]] then fired, destroying the tower and [[Death|killing]] Krennic<ref name="RO" />—former protectee of Thobel<ref name="Geektionary" />—and many rebels and other Imperials below. The blast failed to stop the theft of the plans however, as they had already been transmitted to the [[fleet]]. The rebels managed to escape with the plans<ref name="RO" /> and ultimately used them to destroy the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As a young [[Gender|man]], Thobel had only the vaguest awareness of the profound immorality of his naval career.<ref name="Finest" /> He had light skin and [[Color|gray]] [[eye]]s.<ref name="SWROUVG" />

==Skills and abilities==
Thobel had average speed, strength, intelligence, and [[diplomat]]ic skills. He had slightly below average fighting skills and was not [[Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Corporal Ansin Thobel|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11689220}}</ref>

==Equipment==
[[File:DeathStarTrooperHelmet-HC34.png|thumb|left|200px|Ansin Thobel wore a distinctive Imperial Navy Troopers' helmet.]]
While on duty, Thobel wore a black fabric [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]] including [[glove]]s and a [[belt]] with a secret data [[Officer's disk|compartment]] in the buckle. He donned the distinctive [[helmet]] of the Imperial Navy trooper that had a reinforced neck guard on its chin strap,<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> a built-in [[Comlink|communications tranceiver]], a sweeping area at the back to provide additional head and neck protection, and additional [[radiation]] shielding due to the proximity in which Thobel and his colleagues had to work to the superlaser.<ref name="HC34">{{HelmetCollectionCite|34|Helmets}}</ref> The trooper also carried a [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]], which he stored in a [[holster]] on his right hip.<ref name="SWROUVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ansin Thobel first appeared simultaneously in the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="RO" /> and the young readers book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Secret Mission]]'', which was written by [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="SM">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Secret Mission]]''</ref> with both releasing on [[December 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/rebel-reading-rogue-one-books|text=Rebel Reading: A Guide to ''Rogue One'' Books|author=[[James Floyd|Floyd, James]]|date=2016-12-14}}</ref> The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SWROUVG" />
